none: PAS SUSS-B1E705: Roman denarius possibly of Domitian
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP.CAES.DO-MIT.A V G GERM.P.M.TR P IIII ; R/ IMP

A Roman silver denarius of Domitian (81-96 AD) . Although the legends of the obverse and reverse seem to be extensive, they are generally illegible and it is not possible to make a positive identification of this coin's mint, mint date, or exact RIC reference. Obv. [...]M[...] (OMIT?) [...]III; laureate head facing right. Rev.: [I]MP V[IIII] [...] PP; Minerva standing right on prow, brandishing…
